workItem: Implement policy-bound per-PR auto-merge, fail-closed legacy-template exclusion, and canonical PR Template v1.8 proactive live decision dashboard.
workItemDE: Jeden Pull Request fail-closed gegen den Auto-Merge Safety Contract klassifizieren, Legacy-PR-Vorlagen vollständig vom Merge ausschließen und das Human-Decision-Template als v1.8 mit synchronem, proaktivem Live Dashboard fortführen; v1.7 wird ausschließlich durch den bestehenden Evidence→Decision-Reconciler atomar migriert.
priorityReason: Reduziert manuelle Merge- und Synchronisationsschritte, ohne Human/CODEOWNER-Schutzklassen, Required Checks oder den kanonischen Branch-Writer zu umgehen.
exitGate: Template v1.8 is the only merge-valid PR contract; v1.7 is atomically migratable only by the existing Decision Reconciler; v1.6/v1.5 and markerless bodies remain fail-closed; the live dashboard is derived from the same canonical Evidence state; only exact-head/current-base fully evidenced eligible PRs may be armed.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no direct agent self-merge and no second PR-body or branch-sync writer.
